policies.title: Returns
policies.text: Unopened products can be returned within 7 days of delivery for a full refund.

policies.title: Refunds
policies.text: Prepaid refunds go back to the original payment method within 3–5 working days.
bullets: COD: bank transfer to your account

policies.title: Replacement
policies.text: Damaged in transit or germination below label rate? We inspect and replace, no questions.

escalationSteps.title: Start on WhatsApp
escalationSteps.text: Most issues are resolved in one chat with order ID handy.

escalationSteps.title: Call the helpline
escalationSteps.text: For refunds, COD pickup or urgent sowing-time deliveries.

escalationSteps.title: Ask for a supervisor
escalationSteps.text: If a claim is stuck beyond 48 hours, any agent can escalate it.

footerNote: For order-related issues keep your order ID (FC-XXXX) ready — it speeds everything up.
